description: Retrieval benchmark on XPlan's own source (a real ~40-file TypeScript codebase). Expected files are the ones a maintainer would have to change.

tasks.goal: Add an OpenAI-compatible chat completions provider selectable with --provider openai
Respect .gitignore files in subdirectories, not only the root one, when indexing
Add a YAML output format for the plan command next to markdown and json
Also redact Stripe secret keys (sk_live_ and rk_live_) from prompts and logs
Add a --max-llm-calls option that aborts the planning run when the number of model calls exceeds a budget
Allow the reviewer stage to use a different model than the planner via --reviewer-model
Make the retry backoff for rate limited HTTP requests configurable and cap the total retry time
Resolve Go and Kotlin imports when building the import graph for symbol extraction
